skills.name: Headbutt
skills.description:
Akai charges in the target direction, dealing 300<font color='#D58E1F'>( +50% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color='#C53535'>(Physical Damage)</font> to enemies along the way. If Akai hits an enemy hero during this process, he'll knock them airborne for 0.5s and be able to roll in the Joystick's direction once.
Akai can cast <font color='#404495'>(Headbutt)</font> during <font color='#404495'>(Heavy Spin)</font> to quickly adjust his position.
skills.tips: The long-ranged jump allows for a strong engage into the enemy back line, a narrow escape across walls or just a really good ambush. Remember that when enemy's are marked by Blender (with the Froggy symbol floating on their heads) jumping on them will stun them.

skills.name: Body Slam
skills.description: Akai smashes the ground with his body, dealing 270<font color='#47BE34'>( +6% Total HP)</font> <font color='#C53535'>(Physical Damage)</font> to nearby enemies and slowing them by 45% for 2s.
skills.tips: Blender is Akai's poking skill. The projectile explodes upon impact or at maximum range, and has a relatively wide AoE, making it very easy to mark targets. The most important part of this ability is that attacking targets marked by Blender allows Akai to deal extra 5% of Akai's Max HP as physical damage, which is A WHOLE LOT OF FREAKING DAMAGE.

skills.name: Heavy Spin
skills.description:
Akai removes all debuffs on him and spins for 4s, gaining Slow Immunity while continuously dealing 200<font color='#D58E1F'>( +100% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color='#C53535'>(Physical Damage)</font> to nearby enemies and knocking them back. Enemy heroes knocked back will knock back other heroes they collide with during the process.
Akai also gradually increases his Movement Speed by 70% over the duration. This skill can only be interrupted by Suppression and Morph effects.
skills.tips: Hurricane Dance is Akai's disruptive skill. Aside from the annoying knock back and wall pinning, Akai is immune to slowdown effects and has increased movement speed during the ULT duration. Akai's ULT also works as a Purify which clears all CC and Stun effects on him.

skills.name: Tai Chi
skills.description:
Akai gains a 25<font color='#47BE34'>( +5% Total HP)</font> shield for 4s on each skill cast and marks enemy heroes and Creeps hit by his skills.
Akai's Basic Attacks deal 25<font color='#47BE34'>( +5% Total HP)</font> extra <font color='#C53535'>(Physical Damage)</font> to marked enemies.
skills.tips: Getting a Shield on every skill cast makes Akai rathertanky during the early game, as well as provides a lot of opportunities foroutplays. The extra shield makes Akai a very formidable opponent in a 1v1scenario. When jungling, space out the usage of Skill 1 and Skill 2 to allow your shield to tank the damage from the jungle monsters, as Akai's passive shield has an internal cooldown.

items.name: Oracle
items.des: Unique Passive - Bless: Received Shield and HP Regen effects are increased by 30%.

items.name: Dominance Ice
items.des: Unique Passive - Arctic Cold: Reduces the Attack Speed of nearby enemy heroes to 70% of normal.

items.name: Immortality
items.des: Unique Passive - Immortal: Revives 2.5s after death, gaining 16% Max HP and a 220-1200 shield (scales with level) that lasts 3s (210s cooldown).

items.name: Athena's Shield
items.des: Unique Passive - Shield: Upon taking Magic Damage, gains 25% Magic Damage Reduction for 3s (applied before taking damage). Regains this effect 5s after leaving combat.

items.name: Guardian Helmet
items.des: Unique Passive - Recovery: Regenerates 2.5% Max HP per second (reduced to 0.5% Max HP per second over 5s after taking damage).

builds.tips: As always, builds aren't fixed, especially for tanks. But these are my two general builds. 1) If you want to play more fighter like, you can take Blade of the 7 Seas earlier on. 2) If you want to have some fun with the AoE slow, you can try Thunder Belt. 3) If enemy has a lot of Crit, for example Marksman, Heart of Steel is a very good alternative item.
